title: Conceptual design of a small electric general aviation aircraft
author: Itamar Edson Leite Lessa
abstract: In the society of the green-effects gas discussions, new technological solutions raised-up and others improved. Studies of the electric propulsion or hybrid systems represent a big parcel of them. In this report an electric club aircraft design will be treated applying important concepts present in reputed design books, linear aerodynamic approaches, engine and aircraft performance, stability and controllability of stabilizers, mathematical treatment of experimental curves, CAD modelling and programming in MATLAB for the calculations and/or interfaces.
